name: areDomainAdminAccountsSeparate
definition: True when every enabled user in the on-premises Domain Admins group (nested groups expanded) is read and none has an Exchange mailbox, i.e. administrators do not use their daily-use accounts.
population: enabled user accounts that are effective Domain Admins members of one AD domain; denominator = judged members
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete Domain Admins member list in which every enabled member's mailbox state was read and none has a mailbox; a mail attribute alone is a finding, not a fail.
citations: Product decision: a mail attribute alone is a finding, not a fail; fail only on an Exchange mailbox
